Professional melee players on average made 6 inputs a second.
Wave dashing (jump, angled diagnally down, air dodge) short hop (angle down ans jump) nair (a while in the air) fast fall (pressing down while in the air) L-cancel (pressing L 13 frames before hitting the floor) was something drilled into me because i played with competitive melee players before I myself went competitive with Sm4sh. I played Melee, PM, Sm4sh, and Ultimate with them and other competitive smash players back before ultimate came out. After ultimate came out I couldnt keep up with them because of work and life getting in the way but i still cant forget the inputs. Its muscle memory and to this day when i get my hands on a GCC i do them lol

I miss those days

You think THIS breaks your game? 

In Ben 10: Alien Force, there are specific missions designed for specific aliens Ben/The Player has access to. 

You get JetRay (can fly and swim), Swampfire (plant+fire manipulator), SpiderMonkey, Humungasaur and Big Chill. 

During JetRay’s parts you swim through the water. If you do his flipping laser attack too many times it actually causes you to be able to go off the screen completely. 
You also are stuck as JetRay past that part and are stuck in his swimming animation. You legit have to make it to A cutscene (sometimes it won’t be the next) to fix the game.
